normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 4 Adult bikes- Close proximity to trails and lakes- 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle *(Available only from March-October)- Community pool- Pet-friendly (fee associated).- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Convenience meets comfortable, coastal luxury at 20 Ashley Lane, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in Blue Mountain Beach. A premier community in Scenic 30A, guests can enjoy adventure-filled days exploring the rare coastal dunes, cruising along the lauded Timpoochee Trail, or relaxing on the sugar-sand beach. Guests will be enchanted by this pet-friendly home’s gorgeous indoor and outdoor living spaces and quick 2-minute access to the nearest beach!Cheerful blue accents and chic beach décor mix with elegant fixtures and furnishing inside this tasteful home. Natural light shines off the beautiful hardwood floors and highlights the glamorous coffered ceiling in the open-concept great room, which offers ample space to relax with family and friends. The soft, spacious sectional couch entices guests to gather for a movie night on the 55" TV. Epicureans will delight upon seeing the white marble countertops and Samsung appliances in the fully stocked kitchen. Prepare an evening meal to share at the traditional dining table that seats up to 6 with a mix of chairs and bench seating, with 4 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Out the back door awaits a screened-in porch with a Weber propane grill and 2 chairs—the perfect spot to spend a laid-back afternoon barbecuing the catch of the day!For sleeping accommodations, head upstairs to discover 2 guest bedrooms with a queen bed each, 1 bunk room outfitted with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed and access to a furnished deck with stunning views that span the front of the home. There's a Samsung washer and dryer down the hallway for convenience.Bring friends and family together for an unforgettable Blue Mountain Beach vacation at 20 Ashley Lane. Exploring the community and Scenic 30A is easy, with on-site parking for 4 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes. To access Blue Mountain Beach, take Ashley Lane north to Cabana Trail and turn left. Then, take a right to stay on Cabana Trail until reaching Matt's Way and turn left onto County Highway 30A. Follow this straight to the beach! Book this delightful coastal home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400.**Please note that in order to utilize the golf cart that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Blue Mountain Beach "Stay Awhile" 20 Ashley Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 7 Sleeps 10 Full Baths 3 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 4 Adult bikes - Close proximity to trails and lakes - 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle *(Available only from March-October) - Community pool - Pet-friendly (fee associated). - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Convenience meets comfortable, coastal luxury at 20 Ashley Lane, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in Blue Mountain Beach. A premier community in Scenic 30A, guests can enjoy adventure-filled days exploring the rare coastal dunes, cruising along the lauded Timpoochee Trail, or relaxing on the sugar-sand beach. Guests will be enchanted by this pet-friendly home’s gorgeous indoor and outdoor living spaces and quick 2-minute access to the nearest beach! Cheerful blue accents and chic beach décor mix with elegant fixtures and furnishing inside this tasteful home. Natural light shines off the beautiful hardwood floors and highlights the glamorous coffered ceiling in the open-concept great room, which offers ample space to relax with family and friends. The soft, spacious sectional couch entices guests to gather for a movie night on the 55" TV. Epicureans will delight upon seeing the white marble countertops and Samsung appliances in the fully stocked kitchen. Prepare an evening meal to share at the traditional dining table that seats up to 6 with a mix of chairs and bench seating, with 4 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Out the back door awaits a screened-in porch with a Weber propane grill and 2 chairs—the perfect spot to spend a laid-back afternoon barbecuing the catch of the day! For sleeping accommodations, head upstairs to discover 2 guest bedrooms with a queen bed each, 1 bunk room outfitted with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed and access to a furnished deck with stunning views that span the front of the home. There's a Samsung washer and dryer down the hallway for convenience. Bring friends and family together for an unforgettable Blue Mountain Beach vacation at 20 Ashley Lane. Exploring the community and Scenic 30A is easy, with on-site parking for 4 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes. To access Blue Mountain Beach, take Ashley Lane north to Cabana Trail and turn left. Then, take a right to stay on Cabana Trail until reaching Matt's Way and turn left onto County Highway 30A. Follow this straight to the beach! Book this delightful coastal home today!
